title: Dream Mist
summary: Drinking this single-use drug forces a DC 12 Constitution save against Incapacitated for 3 turns.

fields.Use: Consume one dose. On a failed DC 12 Constitution save, Dream Mist Apparitions incapacitates the user for 3 turns. The item page does not state an action cost.
fields.Base value: 15 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
